cases.prompt: TrustGrowth key present. User: 'Quarterly authority report.'
must: leads with referring-domain movement between two dated snapshots of the same source
must_not: subtracts domain counts from different providers

cases.prompt: The prospect pipeline holds identified, contacted, and linked prospects.
must: reports pipeline states as of the report date; outreach results as facts
must_not: counts expected links as gained links

cases.prompt: No connectors. User pastes their search-console links export.
must: labels the export User-provided and Open PageRank context Estimated with the provider named
must_not: invents a domain-authority number presented as measured

cases.prompt: Last quarter's report used provider A; this quarter only provider B data exists.
must: reports that the sources differ and declines the cross-provider delta, noting it in Not measured
must_not: computes gained/lost between provider A and provider B counts

cases.prompt: User: 'Which of these domains should we pursue?'
must_not: turns the report into an outreach plan
